purpose: Remake all three event brief illustrations in Andrea’s graphic-novel illustration style, preserving transparent backgrounds.

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a wide transparent cutout illustration for an educational presentation card.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE: Andrea, a young adult illustrated in polished contemporary graphic-novel/anime-influenced style. Match its refined dark ink contours, believable facial anatomy and hands, expressive natural-sized eyes, detailed hair strands, warm skin tones, clean layered cel shading, teal clothing, and carefully rendered fabric folds. Image 2 is the SCENE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE to remake in this style. Replace the flat simplified clip-art look of image 2 completely with the illustration style of image 1.
Compose one wide landscape illustration, about 2.35:1 aspect ratio, as a compact coherent cluster with only modest transparent margins. All figures and important props must be fully inside the canvas. Keep it legible when reduced to approximately 410 by 180 pixels on a pale grey slide card. Use fewer, larger and more expressive elements rather than tiny detail. Teal, navy, cream, warm natural skin and modest terracotta accents. Transparent background with genuine alpha, including empty gaps between props and people. No rectangular or colored backdrop, no vignette, no atmosphere, no halo, no outer glow, no scene-wide shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks. Opaque fills inside characters, furniture and papers.
Subject: a friendly classroom learning conversation between two people behind a compact desk: Andrea (recognisably the same curly brown-haired young man with teal zip hoodie and white T-shirt as image 1) and a young adult female teacher with tied-back dark brown hair and a muted terracotta cardigan. They look at one another thoughtfully while discussing a lesson. In front: one small teal laptop and a large open cream workbook with simple teal blocks, plus one checklist sheet and a pencil. Behind and to their right, just three small connected rounded concept-map nodes with a sprout, a graduation cap, and a simple image symbol. Preserve the general story and wide visual balance of image 2. Keep the people the focal point; avoid decorative clutter.
